meta.title: Better plan
meta.description: Two phases — ask, then plan — settled on a right-sidebar panel with one click. The agent publishes questions with clickable options (one recommended and pre-selected), you confirm the batch once, then it publishes an ordered plan you confirm the same way; only a confirmed plan is implemented. The chat-input icon turns the discipline on or off (blue = on) and right-click opens the panel. Each conversation has its own panel state, so two windows never share questions; state lives in $DSH_HOME/better-plan/<session>.json and is removed with the plugin. It adds about 1.7k input tokens per model request while on (discipline text plus two tools) and it deliberately keeps asking after a non-recommended answer until you confirm the follow-up round. When turned off, no discipline is injected and confirmations wake no agent.
